definitions.explanation: Describes pleasantly cool weather or temperature, especially refreshing coolness in summer or after hot weather.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{涼|すず}しい⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧⟦ね→ね：09474_ne⟧。
⟦{秋|あき}→秋：02276_aki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{涼|すず}しく⟦なります→なる：01970_naru⟧。
{涼|すず}しい⟦{風|かぜ}→風：00641_kaze⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{気持|きも}ち→気持ち：01385_kimochi⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧。

examples.english: It's cool at the top of the mountain, so it's easy to spend time there even in summer.

examples.japanese: ⟦{窓|まど}→窓：02254_mado⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|あ}けたら→開ける：00563_akeru⟧{涼|すず}しい⟦{空気|くうき}→空気：01390_kuuki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{入|はい}って→入る：00494_hairu⟧⟦きました→来る：00254_kuru⟧。
examples.english: When I opened the window, cool air came in.

notes:
{涼|すず}しい is an i-adjective meaning pleasantly cool or refreshing - the comfortable coolness that brings relief from heat.

USAGE:
{涼|すず}しい modifies a noun directly ({涼|すず}しい⟦{風|かぜ}→風：00641_kaze⟧, "a cool breeze") or stands as a predicate (⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{涼|すず}しい, "the room is cool"). The adverb {涼|すず}しく pairs with verbs of change — {涼|すず}しく⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧ ("to cool down"). Unlike the often-negative ⟦{寒|さむ}い→寒い：00664_samui⟧, it always carries a positive sense of refreshing comfort.
{涼|すず}しい has a positive connotation of refreshing comfort, unlike ⟦{寒|さむ}い→寒い：00664_samui⟧ which implies uncomfortable cold.

FORMS:
- Negative: {涼|すず}しくない
- Past: {涼|すず}しかった
- Adverb: {涼|すず}しく

TEMPERATURE ADJECTIVES COMPARISON:
- {涼|すず}しい: pleasantly cool (positive)
- ⟦{寒|さむ}い→寒い：00664_samui⟧: cold (often uncomfortable)
- ⟦{暑|あつ}い→暑い：00619_atsui⟧: hot (often uncomfortable)
- ⟦{暖|あたた}かい→暖かい：00618_atatakai⟧: warm (pleasant)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {涼|すず}しい⟦{風|かぜ}→風：00641_kaze⟧: cool breeze
- {涼|すず}しい⟦{顔|かお}→顔：00558_kao⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to act nonchalant (idiom)
- {涼|すず}しく⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to become cool
